name: week
title: Function week
subtitle: Booked times use each room timezone. Review tentative holds before confirming.

sections.title: Diary
sections.sql: select event,session,room,status,guests,local_start,local_end,timezone from function_diary where ends_at>=now() and status in ('confirmed','tentative') order by starts_at

sections.title: Recorded event money
sections.note: Amounts follow the event currency. Contribution subtracts recorded item costs only. It excludes labour and overhead unless entered as items. This is not a tax invoice or profit statement.

sections.title: Menus and dietary review
sections.sql: select event,guests,numbers_confirmed,dietary_notes,dietary_reviewed,item,quantity,allergens,allergen_verified,service_at from kitchen_handover order by service_at
sections.note: A recorded check is evidence for review, never a guarantee that food is allergen free.
